mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dispatch_recommendation ( dispatch_task_id, user_id, distance_meter, match_score, recommend_status ) VALUES ( #{dispatchTaskId}, #{userId}, #{distanceMeter}, #{matchScore}, #{recommendStatus} )
